name: Montclair Place
description: Montclair Place is a premier regional shopping destination in the Inland Empire, offering visitors an exceptional mix of popular retailers, diverse dining options, and entertainment experiences. The center features a modern, climate-controlled environment with convenient amenities including pet-friendly policies and guest services designed to enhance the shopping experience. With its strategic location and comprehensive tenant mix, Montclair Place serves as a community hub for shopping, dining, and entertainment.
demographics: Montclair Place attracts a diverse, family-oriented shopper base with a strong representation of middle to upper-middle income households from the Inland Empire region. The primary trade area includes young families and millennials aged 25-45, along with value-conscious shoppers seeking a mix of affordable fashion and dining options. Visitors typically come from surrounding communities including Ontario, Upland, and Pomona, drawn by the mall's accessibility via the I-10 freeway and its blend of national retailers and dining destinations.
summary: Montclair Place is a leading regional mall in the Inland Empire offering diverse shopping, dining, and entertainment options in a modern, family-friendly environment.
